text: {"claims": [{"id": "c1", "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P3.S6", "rel": "entails", "sub": "Edit redis.conf"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P1.S1 requires updating redis.conf to match, and P1.S2 warns that skipping it loses the changes; P3.S6 also includes editing redis.conf."}, {"id": "c3", "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S2", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "Stop all the writes against the database!"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "The procedure instructs the operator to stop writes manually; no sentence says Redis blocks writes automatically, and P3.S2 is incompatible with that."}, {"id": "c5", "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "Since Redis 7.0.0"}], "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "7.0", "op": ">=", "right": "7.0.0"}, "reasoning": "P4.S0 states an AOF-only instance can still be backed up; the 7.0.0 date appears in P4.S1 but concerns file splitting, not the backup capability itself."}, {"id": "c6", "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "appenddirname"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P4.S1 names the configuration option `appenddirname`, not `appendfilename`, so the claim misstates the option."}, {"id": "c11", "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "Prior to version 7.0.0"}], "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "6.0", "op": "<", "right": "7.0.0"}, "reasoning": "P7.S0 says backing up the AOF file prior to 7.0.0 is done simply by copying the aof file; 6.0 precedes 7.0.0 per the check."}]}
